# Pinterest Netherlands (nl.pinterest.com)

> > Pinterest Netherlands hosts verified merchant profiles and official brand accounts showcasing luxury products, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle collections.

nl.pinterest.com is the Dutch version of Pinterest, featuring official brand accounts from premium merchants across luxury watches, cosmetics, fashion, botanicals, and high-end marketplaces. The platform serves as a visual discovery and shopping destination for curated product collections and lifestyle inspiration.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest official accounts
- Verified merchants
- Luxury watches
- Fashion accessories
- Cosmetics and beauty
- Orchid collections
- Botanical products
- Luxury marketplace
- Product showcase
- Brand profiles
- Aesthetic design
- Independent designers
- Real estate and luxury goods
- B Corp certified
- E-commerce integration

## Luxury Brand Profiles

- [Burker Watches (burkerwatchesofficial)](https://nl.pinterest.com/burkerwatchesofficial/): Official Pinterest account showcasing aesthetic gold and silver women's watches with vintage-retro style appeal
- [Rituals Cosmetics (ritualsofficial)](https://nl.pinterest.com/ritualsofficial/): B Corp certified luxury home and body products with premium cosmetics and wellness collections
- [James Edition - The World's Luxury Marketplace (jamesedition)](https://nl.pinterest.com/jamesedition/): Luxury marketplace profile featuring real estate, cars, yachts, and exclusive high-end goods

## Fashion & Lifestyle Merchants

- [SADARO (sadaroshop)](https://nl.pinterest.com/sadaroshop/): Trendy fashion and lifestyle products with style inspiration and fashion accessories collections
- [Pixie Rebels (pixierebels)](https://nl.pinterest.com/pixierebels/): Niche fashion by independent designers and emerging brands with unique aesthetic appeal

## Botanical & Floral Collections

- [Opti-flor (optiflor)](https://nl.pinterest.com/optiflor/): Premium 5-star orchid collections and botanical products featuring diverse orchid varieties and floral design inspiration
